Print this before the session. Every question below can be run with no network, no projector, and no polling service.

## 1. What is Epidemiology?

*Explanation:* The study of the distribution and determinants of health-related states or events (e.g. infectious disease) in specified (human) populations and the application of this study to control health problems

*Fallback:* Read the question aloud, then take a show of hands for each option in turn and record the counts on the whiteboard.

## 2. Ebola virus cases in parts of Africa exceed what is normally expected for that region. In this situation, the Ebola virus was [a/an] ________.

- **A.** endemic
- **B.** epidemic **(correct)**
- **C.** pandemic

*Explanation:* An epidemic is the occurrence of disease cases above what is normally expected in a population or region.

*Fallback:* Read the question aloud, then take a show of hands for each option in turn and record the counts on the whiteboard.

*Online version:* <https://PollEv.com/multiple_choice_polls/IbKVVt4vgCRC64HyxiSYr/respond?q=epidemic-01>

## 3. Malaria is always present in Africa due to the presence of infected mosquitoes. In this situation, malaria is [a/an] ________.

- **A.** endemic **(correct)**
- **B.** epidemic
- **C.** pandemic

*Explanation:* An endemic disease is consistently present at an expected baseline level in a population or region.

*Fallback:* Read the question aloud, then take a show of hands for each option in turn and record the counts on the whiteboard.

*Online version:* <https://PollEv.com/multiple_choice_polls/BeylIlOHiqqCwIu67t3vK/respond?q=endemic-01>

## 4. Between 2019 and 2023, the SARS-CoV-2 virus infected more than 600 million people worldwide. In this situation, the SARS-CoV-2 virus was [a/an] ________.

- **A.** endemic
- **B.** epidemic
- **C.** pandemic **(correct)**

*Explanation:* A pandemic is an epidemic that spreads across countries or continents and affects a large number of people.

*Fallback:* Read the question aloud, then take a show of hands for each option in turn and record the counts on the whiteboard.
